snippet.title: Can Anything Break A G-Shock?😳⌚
snippet.description:
In the 1980s, Casio claimed its G-Shock watch was indestructible, and its ad showed a hockey player hitting it like a puck at the net while it kept ticking. People called the ad fake, so people all over the world tested the G-Shock themselves. Its inventor, Kikuo Ibe, made the inside of the watch float so the case takes every hit. It survived a helicopter drop, a McLaren and a 34 ton lorry, until a hydraulic press finally crushed it ⚡

Credit: Teddy Baldassarre, Nico Leonard, Crazy Hydraulic Press, Casio

snippet.title: The RISKIEST Marketing Of All Time!?😳📈
snippet.description:
Jim "Mattress Mack" McIngvale, the owner of Gallery Furniture in Houston, promised customers who spent $3,000 or more their money back if the Houston Astros won the 2022 World Series. Thousands of people bought in, so an Astros win meant he owed them about $75 million. He had already been burned in 2014, when he made the same promise and Seattle won the Super Bowl. This time he also bet about $10 million on the Astros, so when they won, the sportsbooks paid him around $75 million and he used it to pay every customer back. ⚡

snippet.title: The Day Angry Grandpa Stopped Being Angry…🥹❤️
snippet.description:
Angry Grandpa was famous on YouTube for yelling at everything, but there was one thing he never got over: the '55 Chevy he lost when he was a teenager. His mother gave it to his sister for a trip to California, it broke down on the way, and it ended up in a junkyard. snippet.title: He Tried To Walk Around The Earth…😳🌍
snippet.description:
Karl Bushby left his mom's house in 1998 and promised her he wouldn't come back until he walked around the entire planet, with no cars, no boats and no planes. His plan was to walk from the very bottom of South America back home to England in 12 years. But it ended up taking him 28 years. First he had to survive the deadliest jungle on Earth. Then he walked across a frozen ocean into Russia, and got arrested the second he arrived. Then he got trapped in Kazakhstan, with a whole sea blocking his way. So he swam it, for 31 days. And this is the moment he finally keeps his promise to his mom ⚡

Credit: ITV News, BBC, Sky News, Associated Press, NBC News, Karl Bushby, NASA, ESA

snippet.title: Ronaldo Played Football In Disguise…😳⚽
snippet.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo put on a fat suit, a fake beard and a wig and played football on the street in disguise, in the middle of Madrid. Everyone thought he was just some homeless guy and walked right past him. He asked one woman for her phone number and she said no. Almost an hour went by and nobody recognized him, until one little boy kicked the ball back and started playing with him. Then he pulled off the beard and the boy realized who it was. And the only boy who gave him a chance got a signed ball, while everybody else came running back ⚡

snippet.title: The Truth Behind The VIRAL Equator Trick…🤯🌍
snippet.description:
People believe water spins the other way when you cross the Equator, and one viral video of it got 43 million views. So two science YouTubers tested it: Destin from Smarter Every Day tested his sinks and toilets in America, and Derek from Veritasium tested his in Australia. In both countries, some spun one way and some spun the other. So how do the equator shows do it? In Uganda, right after the guide pours the water, he sticks a paddle in it, and when he pulls it out he swipes it sideways and sets the spin himself. The bowls even have spirals painted on them. And tourists tip him for the show ⚡

Miami bond court, 2015: Judge Mindy Glazer looked at the man in front of her, Arthur Booth, and asked if he went to Nautilus Middle School. They had been classmates, and she remembered him as the nicest kid in school. She still had to set his bond. He spent 10 months in jail, and when he walked out she was waiting for him at the door. In 2024 he stood in front of her again on new charges, and she stepped aside so another judge could hear his case ⚡

snippet.title: She Fainted During Her Routine…😱💔
snippet.description:
At the 2022 World Championships in Budapest, artistic swimmer Anita Alvarez passed out at the end of her solo and sank to the bottom of the pool while the crowd was still clapping. The lifeguards weren't allowed in until a judge stopped the routine, and no judge did. Her coach Andrea Fuentes had pulled her out of the water once before, so she didn't wait. Watch what she did next ⚡

snippet.title: He DOUBLED His Dopamine For 7 Days…🤯📉
snippet.description:
Will Tennyson spent 7 days doubling his dopamine, keeping everything from the day before and adding something stronger each day: 2 hours of doomscrolling, then junk food, lottery tickets, sports bets, a rented Ferrari, a shopping spree and a trip to a Miami casino. Every morning he rated his baseline happiness, and it went from a 30 to a 26, then 23, then 18. By the last morning it was a four, and he said nothing felt exciting anymore ⚡

snippet.title: The Sharks Turned Down A BILLION Dollar Company…😳💰
snippet.description:
Allison and Stephen Ellsworth walked into Shark Tank in 2018 with Mother, an apple cider vinegar soda, asking for $400,000 for 10% of their company. Kevin O'Leary called them beverage cockroaches, and Kevin, Mark Cuban, Lori Greiner and Bethenny Frankel all went out. Only guest shark Rohan Oza made an offer: $400,000 for 25%. They renamed it Poppi, and in 2025 PepsiCo bought it for $1.95 billion ⚡

snippet.title: No Woman Had Ever Beat A Man…😳🎯
snippet.description:
In December 2019, 25-year-old Fallon Sherrock walked onto the Alexandra Palace stage as a 6-to-1 underdog against world number 77 Ted Evetts, and no woman had ever won a match at the PDC World Championship. She trailed 1-2 in sets, came back to 2-2, then finished the decider on double 18 to win 3-2. Four days later she beat 11th seed Mensur Suljovic 3-1 with an 86 checkout on the bullseye, and the run earned her the nickname Queen of the Palace ⚡

snippet.title: His Son Would Only Drink From ONE Cup…🥹🥤
snippet.description:
In November 2016, Marc Carter, a full-time carer in the UK, tweeted a plea for a discontinued Tommee Tippee cup because his 14-year-old autistic son Ben would drink from nothing else and the old one was falling apart. Ben had already ended up in hospital with dehydration after refusing replacement cups. The tweet was shared more than 19,000 times, and a factory in Dongguan, China, that still had the original mould restarted production, with reports putting the run at 500 to 1,000 cups. Tommee Tippee promised Ben a lifetime supply ⚡

snippet.title: He Took On A Food Challenge That Had NEVER Been Beaten…😳🍔
snippet.description:
BeardMeatsFood took on the Seven Deadly Sins Challenge at Sin City Social, a Pulp Fiction themed diner in Liverpool, a challenge nobody had ever finished. Two burgers, wings, chicken tenders, a giant mozzarella stick, fries and a milkshake, and before he started the restaurant cut the time limit from 60 minutes to 45 and added two extra sets of fries. He finished all of it in 31 minutes, then ordered two more burgers and dessert ⚡

snippet.title: I Kinda Feel Bad For Him…😳❤️
snippet.description:
At the 2025 Plovdiv Sabre World Cup quarterfinal, 19-year-old Harvard freshman Colin Heathcock was tied 9-9 with Olympic champion Oh Sang-uk when Oh's clean hit to the head never lit up the scoring box. The officials tested the equipment, found nothing wrong, and the point was gone. Heathcock knew the hit was real, so on the restart he lowered his sabre and let Oh have it back. What that one point ended up costing him is the part nobody talks about ⚡

snippet.title: He Heckled The Wrong Tennis Player…😂🎾
snippet.description:
At the 2017 Wimbledon ladies' invitational doubles, Kim Clijsters asked where to serve, and a fan in the stands shouted "body serve!" So the former world number one invited him onto the court, put him in one of her own skirts to meet the all-white dress code, and served it right at his body. He got it back ⚡
